description: The one-call answer to 'can I work on this issue right now': the Claim Protocol issue status (claim holder, expiry, queue, competing PRs, gates) plus the repo friction summary (how hard this repo is to land a PR in, 0-100). Call this before committing to any issue; it combines claim_status and repo_friction.

issue_url.description: Full GitHub issue URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123

name: preflight
